name: Priya
role: Telesales / inside-sales rep (CPG & Manufacturing order desk), 4 years experience
context: On a live phone call with a store buyer, capturing and adjusting the order's assortment line items in real time while the customer dictates quantities and asks about promotions.

jtbds.goal: As the buyer dictates quantities, adjust the order quantities across the assortment line items and commit the changes before the call ends.
jtbds.trigger: The buyer is on the line reading off the products and case counts they want for this order.
jtbds.success_criterion: The quantities the customer asked for are captured against the correct products and the changes are saved to the order.
jtbds.stake: If the quantities aren't captured and saved before the call ends, the rep has to call back or the order ships wrong.

jtbds.goal: Tell the customer which products carry free-item promotions and how many free units they will receive.
jtbds.trigger: The buyer asks 'what am I getting free on this order?' while deciding how much to buy.
jtbds.success_criterion: The rep can accurately state, per qualifying product, that a free-item promotion applies and how many free units it yields.
jtbds.stake: A wrong free-item quote on the call erodes buyer trust and can require an order correction later.

jtbds.goal: Mark the order complete once the buyer confirms the final assortment and quantities.
jtbds.trigger: The buyer says 'that's everything, place it' at the end of the call.
jtbds.success_criterion: The order (or its line items) advances to a complete/confirmed state that reflects the agreed quantities.
jtbds.stake: If completion doesn't register, the order sits unsubmitted and the buyer's request is lost.
